name: c08-restaurant-opentable
intent: On opentable.com, find restaurants in Midtown Atlanta with a table for 2 around 7:00 PM on {next_friday}. List three restaurants and the times each has available. Do not reserve.
hard_part: Location + party + time pickers; availability chips
live_stops_before: any sign-in, account creation, add-to-cart, reservation, booking, payment, consent, CAPTCHA or bot check, and every final/commit/protected button
